description: This file defines a Kotlin class `SmsManager` that provides functionality for sending and querying SMS messages on Android devices. It handles permissions, interacts with Android's SMS content providers, manages MMS messages, and serializes data in JSON format. The class includes methods for permission handling, SMS sending, message querying, contact resolution, and message processing.

classes.name: SmsManager
classes.description: A class that manages sending and querying SMS and MMS messages, handling permissions, and serializing/deserializing message data.

classes.name: SmsManager.SendResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of an SMS send operation.

classes.name: SmsManager.SmsMessage
classes.description: Data class representing an SMS message with various metadata fields.

classes.name: SmsManager.SearchResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of querying SMS messages, including success status and messages list.

classes.name: SmsManager.QueryMetadata
classes.description: Information about MMS request eligibility, attempted, and inclusion for a query.

classes.name: SmsManager.ParsedParams
classes.description: Structured parameters parsed from JSON input for sending SMS.

classes.name: SmsManager.ParseResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing successful or error result of parameter parsing.

classes.name: SmsManager.QueryParseResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing success or error in parsing query parameters.

classes.name: SmsManager.QueryParams
classes.description: Parameters used for querying SMS messages, including filters like time range, contact, keyword, type, and limits.

classes.name: SmsManager.SendPlan
classes.description: Data class representing the SMS message parts and multipart usage for sending.

methods.name: hasSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has SEND_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_CONTACTS permission.

methods.name: canSendSms
methods.description: Determines if the device supports sending SMS based on telephony feature and permissions.

methods.name: canSearchSms
methods.description: Determines if searching SMS is possible based on permissions and telephony feature.

methods.name: canReadSms
methods.description: Checks if reading SMS is enabled (same as canSearchSms).

methods.name: hasTelephonyFeature
methods.description: Checks if the device has telephony feature.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a permission requester to handle runtime permission requests.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Suspend function that sends an SMS message using provided JSON input, handling permissions and errors.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Suspend function that queries SMS messages based on provided filters in JSON input, handling permissions, contact lookups, and filtering.

methods.name: ensureSmsPermission
methods.description: Suspends until SEND_SMS permission is granted or returns false.

methods.name: ensureReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Suspends until READ_SMS permission is granted or returns false.

methods.name: ensureReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Suspends until READ_CONTACTS permission is granted or returns false.

methods.name: okResult
methods.description: Creates a successful SendResult object.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Creates a failed SendResult object with error message.

methods.name: queryOk
methods.description: Constructs a successful SearchResult with messages.

methods.name: queryError
methods.description: Constructs an error SearchResult with the error message.

methods.name: getPhoneNumbersFromContactName
methods.description: Retrieves phone numbers associated with a contact name from device contacts.

methods.name: querySmsMessages
methods.description: Queries SMS messages from the device, applying filters.

methods.name: querySmsMmsMessagesByPhone
methods.description: Queries MMS and SMS messages associated with a specific phone number.

methods.name: getMmsTextBody
methods.description: Retrieves text body of an MMS message part.

methods.name: getMmsMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata (message box and read status) for an MMS message.

methods.name: getMmsAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address (phone number) associated with an MMS message.
